F02-8 Commissioning activities of the design and construction phases in order
reviews at 30, 60, 90 % and IFC, comments in 10 working days · FAT procedure 20 days before L1 · L4 scripts approved 10 days before test
• Each of the four design reviews returns its comment log within 10 working days.
• L4 and L5 scripts are finalised from the approved submittals and the final sequence of operations.
